visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men, one wearing a navy blue shirt and the other in a white t-shirt, sit at a dining table indoors. The man in white holds a smartphone showing a side-by-side comparison of himself and a tanned fitness instructor. The background is a grey textured wall with a logo. (2) A third, older man with a very tanned complexion and styled hair enters the frame from the right, wearing a white t-shirt. He places a hand on the shoulder of the man in white, who looks surprised. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor rooftop balcony with a brick railing and city buildings in the background. The three men are standing in a line, performing high-energy aerobic arm pumping and leg lifting movements. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the older man's face as he smiles widely, revealing extremely bright white teeth, followed by an overlay highlighting his teeth. (5) The men continue the workout on the balcony, engaging in jumping jacks and rhythmic clapping. The two younger men appear increasingly exhausted while the older man remains energetic, ending with a coordinated final pose.

(5) Fast-paced vocal cues continue over the driving dance beat, with audible heavy breathing and rhythmic clapping sounds perfectly synchronized with the music's tempo.
